content:
Some colleagues asked me to pass along the following:

A group of mathematicians started a github repository to allow people to comment on and modify the openai-generated papers. The idea is not necessarily to engage with the contents, but to give a platform for mathematicians who would like to do so. 

They are looking for moderators who have expertise in category theory or other topics. See also
https://terrytao.wordpress.com/2026/10/24/oai-math-revised-a-community-hub-for-revising-openais-math-write-ups/. Write to mathcommunityadmin@gmail.com for more details.
